retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome layout featuring a dense crowd of stage performers anchored by a singular silhouette and bold, outlined sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: outlined sans-serif title with speed lines
excludeWhen: modern digital flat design is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A split-level composition where the bottom half is a high-contrast black and white photograph of a large dance ensemble with arms raised, and the top half is a light gray field containing a central female silhouette in a bowler hat and leotard, flanked by heavy-set outlined typography and horizontal speed lines.
coreVisualRelationships: The central silhouette acts as a bridge between the photographic crowd and the graphic title area.
Horizontal speed lines extend from the silhouette to integrate it with the text.
The dense verticality of the crowd's arms contrasts with the horizontal flow of the upper graphic elements.
High-contrast black figures against a neutral gray background create a stark, graphic depth.
coreInvariants: Centralized silhouette in a dynamic pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large ensemble occupies the bottom 50% of the frame; a singular silhouette is centered in the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central silhouette in the bowler hat serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central silhouette, moves right to the large title, then drops to the rhythmic pattern of the crowd's raised arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper gray field provides breathing room for the complex typography and silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for silhouettes and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for highlights and text outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between black figures and gray ground.

letterConstructionRules: Integrated horizontal speed lines extending from letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'J' and 'Z' feature elongated tails that merge into horizontal graphic stripes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A dominant outlined display face paired with a smaller, clean geometric sans-serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Silhouette of a dancer in a bowler hat

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic of the secondary text.
Provides the necessary weight for the outlined title treatment.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome image with a neutral gray top half and a high-contrast black and white photo of a theater ensemble with arms raised on the bottom half. Place a black silhouette of a female dancer in a bowler hat in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, uppercase, double-outlined sans-serif text to the right of the silhouette. Add horizontal black stripes that appear to emerge from the silhouette and the text.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a distinct double-outline effect?
Is the bottom half a dense crowd of performers?
Are there horizontal graphic lines connecting elements?

mustAchieve: High-contrast 'crushed' black levels in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast photographic detail in the crowd.
Ensure the silhouette is solid black without internal detail.
Verify the typography is legible despite the heavy outlines.
Confirm the composition is split roughly 50/50 between graphic and photo.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Ensemble Photo] + [Central Graphic Silhouette] + [Outlined Geometric Typography] + [Horizontal Speed Lines] over a [Neutral Gray Field].
